title: Executive HR Analytics and Workforce Reporting
raw_text: Helvetia Industrial AG wants a single executive view of workforce cost, attrition, and time-to-fill, currently spread across six divisional reporting packs built in different tools. We require a governed semantic model and a Power BI reporting layer replacing those packs, with consistent KPI definitions agreed with HR leadership. Historical comparison across three fiscal years is required. Row-level security must ensure divisional HR managers see only their own division. The model is built on a curated warehouse; the reporting work is the engagement scope, not the warehouse build.
requirements: Power BI reporting layer replacing six divisional reporting packs
Governed semantic model with KPI definitions signed off by HR leadership
Row-level security scoped to divisional HR managers
